scope: Observed harness repairs, with exact engine/model failures retained in the corresponding timestamped reports; this file is an engineering summary, not an invented raw receipt

repairs.failure: initial fresh workspace build could not find dependent package declarations
repairs.repair: build TypeScript project references before running the full workspace build

repairs.failure: UE local derived-data cache default path exceeded the launcher build's path limit
repairs.repair: configure both ordinary and InstalledDerivedDataBackendGraph caches inside the isolated workspace

repairs.failure: shared PCH debug records embedded a transient sandbox path; subsequent compiler/linker temporary paths were stale
repairs.repair: use NoPCHs for the small fixture plugin, stable TEMP/TMP, and NoUBTMakefiles; native build logs retained

repairs.failure: Unreal StaticMesh sockets property is protected in Python
stored FBX reimport settings retained false unit/absolute-transform flags, producing a 100-fold import scale error
repairs.repair: set and save the existing asset import data explicitly; real actor bounds then matched the centimeter contracts

repairs.failure: Unreal Python array += returned None during material asset enumeration
repairs.repair: convert the returned asset array to a Python list before concatenation

repairs.failure: the model test aimed low and the actual native sphere sweep hit the solid sill before reaching the window
repairs.repair: qualified model changed the aim to the reachable frame; keep structural collision and all positive/negative assertions

repairs.failure: model repair changed a horizontal collision probe to a vertical one; a follow-up free-model repair timed out
repairs.repair: restore the original horizontal probes deterministically; raw output and the two corrections are separate

repairs.failure: hidden-window screenshot requests produced no files
repairs.repair: use actual native SceneCapture2D render targets; require a measured capture pass

repairs.failure: native render-target export omitted the PNG extension; first captures were overbright
repairs.repair: export the clean requested filename and reduce the pilot's point-light intensity; original extensionless PNG bytes retained

repairs.failure: assembly-recovery reporting accessed result.placed instead of result.report.placed and threw TypeError after the engine checks
repairs.repair: fix the reporting path, persist intermediate evidence, and rerun the preservation/recovery checks

repairs.failure: reviewer returned no events before the bounded stream timeout
repairs.repair: no fabricated approval or unchanged-route retry; retain the blocked receipt and report FORGEAAA_R82_PARTIAL
